914-3335-8296.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3335-8296.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Lady Sun by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Activate Lady Sun by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
914-3335-8296.notes: If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

116-2645-3430-5873.easyPrerequisites: Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
116-2645-3430-5873.description:
Activate Everglades by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Everglades
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1170-5131-8095-8176--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-8095-8176--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Geist of Saint Thalia.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

687-4613-5231-8130-8135.description:
Cast Vizier of the Scorpion by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Vizier of the Scorpion enters, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Army token.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Vizier of the Scorpion and the creature token, adding two mana.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Vizier of the Scorpion from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-4613-5231-8130-8135.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

2033-4687-4929.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least four counters on it.
2033-4687-4929.description:
Activate Citanul Hierophants by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Cryptic Trilobite, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-1726-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2292-2415-7286.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

277-1308-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

4091-7791-7908.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two Halflings.
4091-7791-7908.description:
Activate The Notary Hobbits by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting The Notary Hobbits.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and The Notary Hobbits.
Repeat.

671-3179-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
671-3179-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

112-4050-6259-7639.description:
Cast Clockspinning by paying {U} due to Samut.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Clockspinning.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2169-6798--5.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 2.

413-856-4321-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
413-856-4321-7396.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar, Blasting Station and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve both Blasting Station triggers from this step and step 3, untapping it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1086-4186-4384.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1086-4186-4384.description:
Gain life.
Treebeard's second ability triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-2511-4875-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-2511-4875-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2366-3480-3688-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3480-3688-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

3057-7074.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
3057-7074.description:
Activate Koh by paying 1 life, causing it to gain Bloodthirster's triggered and activated abilities.
Deal combat damage using Koh, triggering Koh, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat step 2 each combat phase.

1445-5477-7060.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1445-5477-7060.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2061-2104-6991.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation each turn.
2061-2104-6991.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Donnie & April.
Put the Donnie & April token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1978-3443-5143.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
1978-3443-5143.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat

3293-4826-5414-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-4826-5414-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-4826-5414-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

3817-4050-4681.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1575-5226-6748.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing another artifact, which is a Food due to Ragost.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

1495-4613-6582.description:
Activate Aerith Gainsborough by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Aerith Gainsborough triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

703-803-2034-4394.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, mutating it over or under a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two copies of the Feather token that are 3/3 Dragon creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Astral Dragon, adding {C}{C}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

804-4779-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Sakashima the Impostor on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
804-4779-5365.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Sakashima the Impostor's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Sakashima the Impostor.
Sakashima the Impostor's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.
804-4779-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

4740-6191.description:
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to target opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain you 50 life.
Repeat.

2104-2556-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation and Mnemonic Wall each turn.
2104-2556-6122.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying its mana cost.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Mnemonic Wall from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1987-2103-4423-5913.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2103-4423-5913.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak.
When Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

3433-4050-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Hornet Queen to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing Hornet Queen and the four Insect tokens, adding {4}{B}.
Repeat.

1832-2034-3490-4703.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have a way to give Brallin lifelink.
1832-2034-3490-4703.description:
Give Brallin lifelink, if needed.
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
Brallin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2232-3241-4739-4863.notablePrerequisites: You control at least nine creatures.
2232-3241-4739-4863.description:
Cast Battle Hymn by paying {1}{R}, adding at least nine {R}.
Cast Revolutionist by paying {5}{R}.
Revolutionist enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Battle Hymn from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Ghitu Chronicler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Battle Hymn by paying {1}{R}, adding at least nine {R}.
Cast Ghitu Chronicler with kicker by paying {4}{R}{R}.
Ghitu Chronicler enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Ghitu Chronicler trigger, returning Battle Hymn from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Revolutionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

147-565-966-5195.description:
Cast Unsubstantiate by paying {1}{U}, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Orvar, and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Orvar trigger, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
The Dualcaster Mage token enters the battlefield, copying Unsubstantiate, targeting the original Unsubstantiate.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Unsubstantiate, returning the original Unsubstantiate to your hand.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger from step 2, creating a Treasure token.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

1267-2034-4147-5114.notablePrerequisites:
Owlbear Cub and Hua Tuo do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls at least eight lands and is unable to block and kill your creatures.
1267-2034-4147-5114.description:
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Medomai on top of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your combat phase, and declare Owlbear Cub as an attacker, attacking the opponent with eight or more lands.
Owlbear Cub triggers, causing you to look at the top eight cards of your library, put Medomai onto the battlefield tapped and attacking, and put the remaining cards on the bottom of your library.
Deal combat damage with Owlbear Cub and Medomai.
Medomai triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Medomai, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat each turn.

1692-1982-3258.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Sidisi.
1692-1982-3258.description:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a non-legendary copy of Sidisi with haste.
The non-legendary Sidisi enters the battlefield, triggering its exploit ability, sacrificing itself.
Sidisi's second ability triggers, causing you to search your library for Beacon of Tomorrows, put it into your hand, and shuffle your library.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle it into your library.
Repeat.
